name: Asakura Sakura
source:
She goes to train but has no motivation. She routinely takes a bath in the jacuzzi and drinks beer. Her body's metabolic rate is unusually high, and she can lose weight in no time with little exercise, she is also prone to rebounding and gaining weight quickly.

Her husband is working alone and rarely comes home. So he don't notice whether Sakura is fat or skinny when he sees her occasionally. This is the reason why she has become indifferent to maintaining his body shape, but now she thinks it is rather suspicious when someone says, "You've lost weight. (Signs of cheating)
